summary: They say you are not who you claim: {attack group} says your proudest record is false, or that you are not really from {the place}.
realLife: One life: In his first race, for the House in 1972, a local paper called him un-American for weeks, and he lost. In 2004 a group of Swift boat veterans spent millions on ads disputing his war record. Another: Running for the Senate in Wyoming in 2013, she was seen as a carpetbagger, fought publicly with her sister over same-sex marriage, and quit in January 2014 citing family health.
